scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical; executable numerical checks corroborate but cannot replace the proof. The claim concerns all dimensions d>=2 and all stated frustum radii and permits lateral displacement of the base centers. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The full text of McKinney (1974) was not accessible for definitive priority assessment of the cylindrical endpoint.
Only maximizing simplices supported entirely on the two bases are classified; additional boundary-supported equality realizations are not excluded.
The high-dimensional limit fixes the ratio of smaller to larger radius strictly below one; simultaneous ratio-to-one limits are not treated.
Novelty is subject to additional specialist historical verification.
title: Sharp simplex-volume phase cascade in Euclidean conical frusta
